description: Regression registry. Every defect confirmed on emjaywellness.com.au gets an entry here so it can never silently return. Add a new entry the moment a defect is found; never delete an entry after it is fixed.

defects.title: Business name spelled consistently as 'Emjay Wellness'
Viewport must allow pinch-zoom (WCAG 2.2 AA, 1.4.4 Resize Text)
defects.source: Confirmed live on every page, 16 August 2026 reconciliation
defects.note: Live value is `width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=0`. maximum-scale and user-scalable=0 stop a user zooming. For an audience of women 45+ who routinely pinch to enlarge text this is among the more consequential accessibility defects on the site. One theme setting. Correct value: `width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0`.

defects.title: White text on #5F9DA0 must use the approved label colour #1c2224
defects.note: White on #5F9DA0 measures 3.08:1 and fails AA. The approved button spec is #1c2224 on #5F9DA0 at 5.23:1, already live on .emjay-btn-primary, .wpw-btn and the Contact form submit. Three rules were never part of that spec and still ship white: .dtb_mobile #dtb-m-menu .dtb-mobile-menu>li:last-of-type>a (mobile menu Book Now, 17px bold), .emjay-btn-secondary:hover, and .et-menu>li.cta-item>a:hover>span. Fix by applying #1c2224 to those three rules. Do NOT change the palette and do NOT substitute #426E70 or #457F81 into button fills: #426E70 is approved for text on pale backgrounds only.

defects.title: Retreat provisions must remain on the legal pages
defects.note: Retreats have not been ruled out. Tinana is on a 12 month tenancy and Belinda still owns the property; destination retreats are under consideration. All retreat clauses in the Privacy Policy, Refunds and Returns and Terms and Conditions are to be RETAINED: the Retreat & Workshop Cancellations section and its 60+ day sliding scale, the force majeure clauses, the photography release covering group events and retreats, and 'Educational workshops and retreats' in the Privacy Policy service list. This entry guards against them being tidied away. Forward-looking legal provisions stay; operational claims that Emjay currently runs retreats are a separate matter and are already correctly absent.

defects.title: Gift certificate provisions must remain on the legal pages
defects.note: Gift products are drafted and dormant rather than deleted, and their future is under review, so the refund and validity provisions stay. EMJ-004 excludes legal pages for this reason: it targets gift certificates being marketed as a live offer, not the terms that cover a dormant one.
